CustomField.description: The Score restated on a 1 to 5 scale, so questions scored on different scales share one axis. The lowest score among the question's options counts as 1, the highest as 5, and the others fall in between in proportion: on a scale of -2 to 2 the answer scored 0 is 3, on 0 to 10 the answer 7 is 3.8. Equal to Score on a question scored 1 to 5. Set on choice answers when the answer is written and again when the Recalculate Results job runs. Blank when the answer has no Score or its question's options carry fewer than two different scores.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Score on a 1 to 5 scale: the question's lowest option counts as 1 and its highest as 5.
CustomField.label: Score (5 Point)
